prompts.jet: Create a production-ready transparent sprite sheet for a hand-painted cartoon anime water cannon in a 2D side-scrolling game. STYLE REFERENCE attached: use its rich cyan/teal water, creamy foam, inked edges, organic painted highlights. The sheet must contain EXACTLY SIX separate VERY LONG HORIZONTAL WATER STREAMS stacked in SIX EVENLY SPACED ROWS, one full-width stream per row. Landscape canvas, about 1536x1024, each stream occupies x=50 to1480 and approximately 105 pixels high, centered in its row. These are six successive ANIMATION FRAMES of one continuous powerful flowing water jet traveling FROM RIGHT TO LEFT. Right endpoint is a small open flowing nozzle attachment, left endpoint breaks into curling foam and spray; between them continuous thin winding strands of water, porous fluid edges, individual falling droplets, white streaks. Same stream footprint and endpoints in every frame, interior water curls and spray visibly advance left frame by frame. No repeating rectangular pieces, no rigid rod, no segmented beam, no cannon, no characters, no background, no writing, no labels, no sheet grid. Transparent empty gutters between rows and transparent background throughout. This is hand-drawn liquid animation, not a solid blue laser. Keep the extreme wide ribbon composition in every row.
prompts.details: Production sprite atlas for painted cartoon anime water effects. Reference image supplies the turquoise/white inked painterly style ONLY. EXACT 4 by 4 equal-cell grid on square canvas; 16 isolated sprites, transparent background and generous clear margins in each cell. Each row is a FOUR FRAME ANIMATION sequence, consistent scale and centered registration. Row 1: a small irregular cluster of three to five INDIVIDUAL teardrop-shaped turquoise water DROPLETS with white highlights, changing shape as they tumble downward; no streak or projectile. Row 2: small water landing splash opening up then collapsing into scattered droplets, very low fluid crown, not a wave. Row 3: shallow flattened wet puddle and scattered foam flecks on the ground viewed from a low side camera, glinting cyan reflections, organic uneven edges, shrinking and fading across frames; no outlined ellipse. Row 4: airy transparent pale cyan water MIST, cloudlets of fine spray dissipating across frames, very soft translucent painted edges but clear hand-painted anime character. All imagery must have real alpha transparency outside the liquid. No diagrams, no vector shapes, no uniform circles, no text, no letters, no borders, no background.
prompts.jetTransparency: Edit this sprite sheet. REMOVE THE ENTIRE BLUE BACKGROUND and make it truly transparent. Preserve ONLY the FIVE long water stream sprites, including their foam and individual droplets, in the same five rows. Preserve their exact shapes, positions, colors, composition and horizontal orientation. Remove the blue field from between the streams, from inside all empty gaps, and from every edge. Actual alpha transparent background, not a blue, black, white or checkerboard background. No new objects. No changes to the water drawings.
